verdict.rationale: Box AI lets users ask questions about, summarize, extract from, and query files stored in Box, with enterprise permissions intact. It also answers questions over curated Box Hubs and auto-extracts metadata such as vendor, dates, and totals, which covers the core of getting AI insights from your own data. However, most evidence describes the Box AI API rather than the in-app experience, and only marketing copy speaks to AI inside the product. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive AI suggestions or recommendations (as opposed to on-demand Q&A and summaries), detailed first-party docs on the in-product AI UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
